proves: people can be outrun: a camp fighter at the reins of a wagon facing west sees the brawler (the slowest hero, 76 px/s) in front of him and drives at him, at the wagon's bandit speed (60); the brawler walks west clear of it, the driver loses sight of him, drives on to where he saw him last and stops; the wagon never reaches him. Control (watched to fail): speed.driver raised to 120 (with the content check's floor lifted for the run), and the wagon catches and rams him
